export.description: Everything as one Excel file — a sheet per domain, with an ID column so the file can be read back in later.

hints.cruises: One row per cruise. Do not change the ID in column A — it is what matches the row back to its record on import. A row without an ID is created as a new cruise.
hints.cruiseStops: One row per port call or sea day. The "Cruise" column points at the "Cruises" sheet through the ID in square brackets.
hints.lodging: One row per property. Stays live on their own sheet, because one property can have any number of them.
hints.lodgingStays: One row per stay. The "Lodging" column points at the "Lodging" sheet through the ID in square brackets. Nights are calculated and cannot be set here.
hints.places: One row per place. Visits live on their own sheet.
hints.placeVisits: One row per visit. The "Place" column points at the "Places" sheet through the ID in square brackets.
